role: machine-readable production exposure policy; engineering/security policy only
invariant: The browser/client sees only the CACE web gateway. All privileged computation, storage, AI, wallet, network-pairing, native and proof services are private/local and mediated server-side.

responsibilities: TLS termination or operation behind a trusted TLS reverse proxy
forbidden: direct database credentials in browser code

private_services.role: canonical Python/C++ scientific execution and verification
directional AI-economy pairing and narrow transport
canonical existing Monero wallet RPC/custody mediation; never browser or AI key access

local_hardening.bind_policy: protected services bind only loopback/private namespace/Unix-domain socket; never 0.0.0.0 or public interface
local_hardening.firewall: default deny inbound to private services; only web gateway may accept client traffic
local_hardening.egress: default deny for scientific/proof services; explicitly allowlisted broker egress only where required
local_hardening.identities: separate least-privilege service identities for gateway, orchestration, scientific workers, AI brokers, wallet brokers, storage and proof runner
local_hardening.filesystem: read-only runtime/package roots where practical; explicit writable workspace/storage paths only
local_hardening.process: no-new-privileges; dropped Linux capabilities; seccomp/AppArmor/container/systemd sandboxing where available
local_hardening.secrets: server-side secret injection only; no secrets in Git, browser bundles, logs or AI context
local_hardening.IPC: typed versioned bounded messages with authentication/peer credentials where supported
local_hardening.audit: append-only security/audit events for privileged mutations and broker actions
local_hardening.updates: pinned/locked dependencies, signed/reviewed deployment artifacts, SBOM and vulnerability scanning where practical

server_mediation_rules: browser never selects or opens arbitrary local paths
browser never submits PASS/VERIFIED/formal promotion as trusted state
browser never talks directly to Ollama/model servers, databases, wallet RPC, Lean runner, C++ workers or pairing transport
gateway/orchestrator revalidates all client data even if browser already validated it
privileged services receive only the minimum typed data/capability required for one operation
formal qualification cannot be triggered as an arbitrary shell command from a public request
wallet signing/custody remains outside AI/model context and client code
production_acceptance: external port scan exposes only intended web gateway ports
private-service bind scan shows no protected public listeners
browser CSP/connect-src permits only intended same-origin/gateway endpoints
negative tests prove browser-origin requests cannot reach protected service sockets directly
secret scan finds no wallet keys/database credentials/model-control secrets in frontend artifacts
scientific/evidence semantics remain canonical behind the gateway
